leadText:
If you were looking for Salvadore, one of Brock's younger brothers, see Brock's siblings.
----
 
Salvador (Japanese: サブロウ Saburō) is a character of the day and a Pokémon Trainer from Cherrygrove City.

Salvador appeared in A Claim to Flame!, as 's first opponent during the Screening Round of the Silver Conference. The computer randomly selected Ash to go first, and Salvador sent out his to Ash's Pikachu. Furret turned out to be a tough opponent, though Ash ultimately won and advanced onto the next stages. It is not known if Salvador won his other two battles in the Screening Round, and therefore it is not known if he moved on in the Silver Conference.
